definitions.explanation: A state of mental or emotional strain, especially before an important event.
A strained state of relations between groups or countries.

notes:
{緊張|きんちょう} has two main uses: personal nervousness and interpersonal/political tension.

SENSE 1 — NERVOUSNESS:
Describes the feeling of being nervous or anxious before something important.
- {緊張|きんちょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be/get nervous
- {緊張|きんちょう}⟦しないで→する：00392_suru⟧: don't be nervous
- {緊張|きんちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{解|ほぐ}れる→解れる：10503_hogureru⟧: nervousness eases
- {緊張|きんちょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{震|ふる}える→震える：02411_furueru⟧: hands tremble from nervousness

SENSE 2 — TENSION (political/social):
Describes strained relations between groups, countries, or people.
- {緊張|きんちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}まる→高まる：02066_takamaru⟧: tension rises/escalates
- {緊張|きんちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: tension continues
- {緊張|きんちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{和|やわ}らげる→和らげる：07897_yawarageru⟧: to ease tension
- {緊張|きんちょう}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧: tense relationship

COMMON COMPOUND:
- {緊張|きんちょう}⟦{感|かん}→感：09847_kan⟧: sense of tension, suspense
